fields.v: No (0): authors from The Memory Company, which builds Spark, the only approach evaluated; the NO-SPARK conditions are the same models without any memory, not an external approach
fields.quote: The NO SPARK baseline condition measures the raw performance of LLMs without access to any external memory.
fields.why: Spark is the only approach evaluated and its vendor wrote the paper; the NO-SPARK baseline is the bare model, not an external approach, so the 'Partly when only some approaches' rule may not apply.
fields.doubt: O único método avaliado é o Spark, da empresa dos autores; o NO-SPARK é só o modelo sem memória (pág. 2), não uma abordagem externa. Decide se Q12 fica Parcialmente ou passa a Não (0).
